xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for GitHub issue #3456 — chokepoint-coverage precursor

plan.title: Chokepoint coverage: dest deletes, plan-mode zero-mutation, schema planned-content

narratives.Description: Precursor for #3437 / PR #3453. Route named dest deletes through containedRemove, chokepoint or relocate temp cleanups, do not validate stale dest in plan mode, document or route legacy-detect, extend the #3392 header, and add a keystone hash test that a full dry-run leaves the fixture tree identical.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator, I want plan-mode and dest deletes to go through the write chokepoint, so that dry-run cannot mutate the tree and collect-only records deletes.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Route slash-deposit dest deletes and the OpenClaw helper equivalents through containedRemove. 2. Route agent-hooks and slash-deposit temp cleanups through containedRemove or write temps outside the project root. 3. Route legacy-detect removeDir through containedRemove. 4. Validate schema projection against planned content; skip dest bytes a skipped write would replace. 5. Keystone: hash fixture tree before and after a full dry-run; assert identical. 6. Extend the #3392 chokepoint header with delete-coverage and plan-mode zero-mutation. 7. CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
narratives.Overview: Scoped precursor. Do not replace #3437 derive-the-plan. Do not fold the --context nit. Do not instance-chase beyond the enumerated sites without the zero-mutation test. Do not touch occupancy.ts, intended-placement.ts, or the 3440/3436 worktrees.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the named dest-delete sites in slash-deposit.ts and the OpenClaw helpers, when they remove a real dest, they call containedRemove (or an equivalent chokepoint that collect-only records).

Given temp cleanups in agent-hooks.ts and slash-deposit.ts, when they run, they go through the chokepoint or the temps live outside the project root. After this story, plan-mode / deft update --dry-run performs zero in-tree filesystem mutations (keystone hash test).

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.test.ts full dry-run leaves the fixture tree byte-identical (#3456)

narrative.Acceptance: Given legacy-detect.ts removeDir, when dry-run would run, it is either routed through containedRemove or the exemption is stated in the chokepoint header. No silent exceptions.

x-directive/evidence.pointer: https://github.com/deftai/directive/pull/3458 merged as 82bd37f3; contained-write.ts header + legacy-detect containedRemove

narrative.Acceptance: Given schema projection, when dest still has bytes a skipped write would replace, validation uses planned content or skips dest validation with an explicit plan-note. Stale dest is never the oracle for a skipped write.
The #3392 chokepoint header states delete-coverage and the plan-mode zero-mutation invariant. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #3456.
